instruments.name: Pre-approved heat early-action grant
instruments.plain_definition: Money and actions approved before the season, released when a specified heat forecast crosses its trigger.
instruments.how_it_breaks_the_cycle: Inferred: pre-authorized funding can reduce delays and protect income/service continuity; actual public-budget savings not established.
instruments.risk_holder: Affected people and public services retain residual losses; grant fund reserves finance pre-agreed action.
instruments.who_pays: Donors or public budget; no individual insurance premium in documented grant models.
instruments.who_receives: Implementing institutions first; people receive defined cash or services.
instruments.speed: Protocol-specific; forecast lead, institutional transfer and service/cash receipt are different clocks.
instruments.typical_cost: No defensible universal unit cost verified; see scheme budget/disbursement ledger. Readiness, delivery and recurrent maintenance all need funding.
instruments.strengths: Can act on income/health risks before an asset-loss claim exists.
instruments.limits: Finite geographic/beneficiary coverage and forecast/delivery constraints.
instruments.basis_risk: Missed forecasts, local exposure and targeting exclusions; false alarms possible.
instruments.reaches_poorest_why: Vulnerability targeting can reach poor/informal households; registries, documentation, mobility and service accessibility still require local checks.
